changes: Shared Android/phone Xtream playback respects provider VOD metadata container_extension instead of always trusting the catalog MP4 fallback
Use validated provider direct_source URLs privately for movies and episodes, retaining signed queries and relative provider routes
Resolve episode source/extension from series metadata when playing from history, including info-level container_extension
Bound private source hints to 512 entries and five-minute expiry; clear with provider metadata, never expose source URLs/credentials to web UI
Normalize dotted/uppercase extensions and reject empty/null/undefined container hints; keep M3U route behavior and live container switching
Allow 45 seconds for VOD/episode preparation instead of 20; live stays 20 seconds, no unbounded retries
Includes previous compact controls, buffering diagnostics, app updates, large theme packs and connection recovery
Authoritative provider hints replace old source values, including removal of an expired/withdrawn direct source
validation: JVM executes actual Xtream and credential code using seeded provider metadata: MKV override, direct/signed/relative URLs, null fallback, episode metadata, history re-resolution and no URLs projected to UI
Pure provider hint tests: cache expiry, kind separation, valid signed sources and invalid schemes/userinfo rejected
Android/phone compilation, signing, embedded TV payload hashes and release checksums verified
Provider removal of a signed direct URL clears old hint immediately; whitespace/null/false placeholder URLs rejected
limitations: No affected customer stream or physical device available; reported -110/-1005 failures still require customer confirmation
Native Android playback remains Android MediaPlayer; ExoPlayer/VLC are not embedded by this release
XCIPTV screenshots show ExoPlayer selected for Live and VLC selected for VOD/Series; per-kind embedded engines remain a separate integration
Samsung Tizen 4 computer package remains experimental; Samsung UA55K6500 from the older Tizen 2.4 generation is not supported by current packages
